prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1139; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give my statement without my name on it, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?

A: I was driving through an intersection in League City, Texas. I had a green light and was heading straight through.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming from my right side pulled out into the intersection and hit the driver's side of my car. I didn't have time to react. It was a side impact, and the force pushed my car sideways.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did your airbags deploy?

A: The side curtain airbag came out on my side. Nothing hit my head directly, but my head snapped toward the window.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day. They told me I have a neck strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff, especially in the morning, and turning to check my blind spot is painful. Headaches come and go, and I've had trouble sleeping because of the pain.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: I've missed a few shifts. I'm trying to work modified duties when I can.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was not at fault. I had the right of way, and I'm hoping this gets resolved so I can focus on recovering.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
